scope: All 36 traits after Primal choice search, shared Spellweaver casts, Solar conversion and melee-limit removal. Supported core means implemented within the declared model, not live-game verification.

classificationDefinitions.supported_core: Main fixed-board combat stat/trigger correctly reaches native/theory; remaining model boundaries stated, not live certification.
classificationDefinitions.partial: Some combat benefit reaches score, with a material omitted or uncertain mechanic.
classificationDefinitions.inert_in_theory: Native hooks exist but immortal target contract never triggers them.
classificationDefinitions.unmodeled: Central trait reward is absent from fixed-board combat score.
classificationDefinitions.structural: Roster/slot/count rule modeled instead of a damage bonus.
classificationDefinitions.economy: No direct fixed-board combat effect; progression/rewards excluded.

blossomVerification.result: PASS: all 5 thresholds grant AD fraction and matching AP plus 10% HP in both equipped Master Yi forms. Adaptor keeps equipped form; equal Blossom normalized bonuses do not alter that comparison.

entries.name: Adaptor
entries.whatIsScored: 25/35/50% AD or AP on members; selected AD/AP kit and equipped Nidalee role.
entries.remaining: Form selection is fixed from equipment/role. Exact treatment of other traits, dynamic stats and ties remains unverified.

entries.name: Apex Predator
entries.whatIsScored: Elder uses 2 slots and contributes 2 Riftbeast total.
entries.remaining: Structural behavior is supported. Elder Alpha execute is a separate trait/kit effect that cannot trigger on immortal targets.

entries.name: Attuned
entries.whatIsScored: Alune's full-moon damage exists (every fifth cast since 2026-09-20); team phase buffs contribute zero.
entries.remaining: Needs verified initial moon phase and cast-driven team windows: 7% durability at/below half moon, otherwise 7% amp. Do not apply both permanently or guess equal uptime.

entries.name: Avatar
entries.whatIsScored: Only generic Lux laser damage; no selected origin or doubled origin count.
entries.remaining: Needs one legal Lux variant, origin count ×2, shared-trait cast mana and variant effects. Use pinned 18.1d values, not July preview numbers.

entries.name: Blackthorn
entries.whatIsScored: No sacrifice or resulting bonuses are scored; the sacrifice hex is empty.
entries.remaining: Needs victim identity, actual removal, role/cost/star rewards and team HP. Pinned HP is 175/300/550; missing tier-4 multiplier and tier-6 preview-versus-asset semantics require resolution.

entries.name: Blossom
entries.whatIsScored: Members gain 12/30/40/45/100% AD and matching AP points, plus 10% max HP in the ordinary item/trait additive percentage pool.
entries.remaining: Wisps, purchases, upgrades and acquired rewards have no supplied state. Adaptor form is selected before traits, but Blossom adds equal normalized AD/AP so it cannot flip that comparison by itself. Master Yi AD and AP both receive both stat bonuses. Without emblem/Avatar states, upper 9/11 thresholds are not reachable by the ordinary distinct-unit board search.

entries.name: Bounty Seeker
entries.whatIsScored: Economy/progression trait; no direct fixed-board combat score.
entries.remaining: Needs chosen bounty, progress and reward/economy state to value attainability. Pinned rewards differ from the pre-PBE overview.

entries.name: Brawler
entries.whatIsScored: Team +120 HP; members add 25/40/65% to the ordinary item/trait HP percentage pool.
entries.remaining: Additive stacking is the adopted model interpretation; current Set 18 aggregation is not independently verified. See data/tft/set18/hp-stacking.md.

entries.name: Caustic
entries.whatIsScored: Kog'Maw's damage applies 30% Sunder/Shred for 4s to the target it lands on; allies hitting that generic target share it while it runs (2026-09-22).
entries.remaining: Nothing reduces a target before his first hit or after the debuff runs out, so provider death is covered. Allies share a target by generic index, the model's usual abstraction.

entries.name: Coven
entries.whatIsScored: No Essence, rituals or acquired rewards are scored.
entries.remaining: Needs history/cashout inputs. Dormant AP-per-Essence rows do not establish live combat AP. Sparse tier-4 loss reward conflicts with archived client value 25.

entries.name: Defender
entries.whatIsScored: Team share +12 armor/MR; members receive +25/60/120 total instead.
entries.remaining: No trait-specific numeric/recipient contradiction found. This is not validation of whole-game accuracy.

entries.name: Eclipse
entries.whatIsScored: No combat effect; eligibility is noted when 3 Solar and 3 Lunar coexist.
entries.remaining: The source minUnits=0 is a placeholder, not automatic activation. Needs delayed (10s, then every 3.5s) lowest-health kill logic and a justified enemy-health model.

entries.name: Elderwood
entries.whatIsScored: No Stonebark bodies, Lifebloom ramp or Deepwood Protector are scored.
entries.remaining: Needs summoned actors, plant positions/survival and star scaling: +25% HP and +10% AP per total Elderwood star. Existing extras include parts of the plants, but not a verified complete implementation.

entries.name: Emerald Aspect
entries.whatIsScored: Taric self healing/shielding and own two-attack charge score; one ally shield is potential only.
entries.remaining: Needs paired ally, its threshold trigger, confirmed charge recipients and area-shield utilization. Pair healing has a preview-versus-pinned-text ambiguity.

entries.name: Executioner
entries.whatIsScored: Precision and +15% crit; at 3/4, 30/40% bonus true bleed over 3s.
entries.remaining: Eligible damage origins and post-death bleed payout are not fully verified or valued by isolated response windows.

entries.name: Fae
entries.whatIsScored: Per assumed pixie: 5/8% AD/AP and 2/4% low-health healing; current assumed counts are 3/7.
entries.remaining: Actual count/progress/history and golden rewards are missing. Fixed 3/7 opening counts are assumptions, not sourced progression. Do not invent output thresholds.

entries.name: Flora Fatalis
entries.whatIsScored: Native takedown hooks exist: 10 mana at 1; also 8% max-HP healing at 2.
entries.remaining: No takedowns occur in theory profiles, so effective score contribution is zero. Assist window and declared enemy-death assumptions are missing.

entries.name: Greenfather
entries.whatIsScored: No cultivated-hex bonus is scored. Ivern damage is measured; ally shields remain potential.
entries.remaining: Needs biome, planted hexes/occupants, prior seeds and timing. Ivern ally amp and post-six-cast AS also lack recipient scoring. Do not assume a fully planted board.

entries.name: Hunter
entries.whatIsScored: +20/30/45/65% AD; +10% amp after 4s on the same primary target, including eligible secondary-target damage.
entries.remaining: **Fixed and native-tested:** amp was restricted to the primary recipient. Target-reset behavior has regression coverage; full-game targeting and immortal-target focus uptime remain approximations.

entries.name: Inferno
entries.whatIsScored: Separate 1/1/2/3% max-HP burn channel for 4s; stacks with the ordinary burn channel.
entries.remaining: Global single-owner suppression undercounts different sources covering different targets. Wound has no value against nonhealing targets; shop ignition is excluded.

entries.name: Invoker
entries.whatIsScored: Nonmembers +1/1/2/2 mana/s; current member totals +4/5/8/11.
entries.remaining: Whether member rows 3/4/6/9 are additional or total is unresolved. Do not replace current totals with another guess.

entries.name: Juggernaut
entries.whatIsScored: Members 20/30/40% durability; other allies 4/6/8%.
entries.remaining: **Fixed:** tier-4 team share was 4%, now 6% from archived CDragon evidence. This reconciles sources; it is not a new patch-note balance change.

entries.name: Lunar
entries.whatIsScored: Members receive 14/20/28/36% AS and matching AP points (twice base share).
entries.remaining: Adjacent nonmembers receive no 7/10/14/18% share. Needs explicit adjacency/overlap recipients; Eclipse is also absent.

entries.name: Monolith
entries.whatIsScored: Malphite receives +10 armor/MR per persistently assigned incoming source, including a stunned source. Opening and live defenses use the same assignments; three source identities are independent of outgoing spread/clump.
entries.remaining: Full-game attacker counts and positioning remain abstract. V3 uses two mirrored focus orientations and retargets after death or untargetability; the earlier one-current-source convention is superseded.

entries.name: Old Growth
entries.whatIsScored: Maokai kit is scored, but prior HP stacks are zero and no new stacks accrue.
entries.remaining: At 1/2★, each eligible death within 3 hexes gives 30 permanent HP. Needs explicit history and future death/range assumptions.

entries.name: Primal
entries.whatIsScored: Explicit legal blessing selections: delayed Tiger, Turtle effective 4% max HP healing every 4s for living allies, Bear 12%-HP executes on finite targets. Resolver exposes 4 single choices or 6 pairs at an actual 4 Primal count; native fields validated by focused regressions.
entries.remaining: Bear cannot trigger on immortal theory targets; Phoenix takedown/component economy has no invented fixed-budget combat credit. Tiger preserves the declared 35% member / 15% nonmember interpretation. Ordinary roster has only 3 actual Primal units until Avatar/emblem state is supplied, so pair support is tested but not naturally reachable by current roster search.

entries.name: Rapidfire
entries.whatIsScored: Allies +10% AS; members +3/5/9/15% per attack, at most 10 stacks.
entries.remaining: Special attack event eligibility and unused duration-row semantics remain unverified.

entries.name: Ravager
entries.whatIsScored: +12/25/40% damage and 10% omnivamp.
entries.remaining: The doubled bonus below 50% enemy HP never activates against full-health immortal targets. Needs explicit health-phase assumptions.

entries.name: Riftbeast
entries.whatIsScored: One selected Alpha. At 7, +5% AD/AP/AS, +5 armor/MR, +50 HP and +1 mana/s at opening and every 5s.
entries.remaining: One explicit Alpha holder; timed 7-piece growth is scored. Mama Beak armor reduction and Pebbles MR reduction are now shared across theoretical actors by native flat-resistance deltas. Sentinel allied cast mana, Scuttle ally healing and effective Krug ally shields remain incomplete; Elder executes stay inactive on immortal targets. Shops/max-team-size are outside the fixed board. Resolver coverage text now reports the shared strip correctly.

entries.name: Rival
entries.whatIsScored: Base Kha'Zix/Rengar kits only; no trait-state combat value.
entries.remaining: Needs takedowns, Kha evolution choices/additional trait counts, Rengar team AD (5% at 30, +0.2% thereafter), and verified Rival(2) cross-cast effects. Detailed source text lives in tier effects, not normalized desc.

entries.name: Solar
entries.whatIsScored: All allies receive shield and bonus damage scaled by actual unique three-star count; at 3 three-stars the existing AS/resists apply. At 5 three-stars, the Threshold2TrueDamageConversion share of the existing bonus (half on 18.1d, 40% on 18.2b; a hardcoded half until 2026-09-22) becomes true damage in ordinary and bridged native paths. No bonus amount is added by conversion.
entries.remaining: Eight-three-star recurring four-star ascension remains absent. Existing Solar damage-origin/proc classification is retained, including no recursive bonus procs and exclusion of raw/true source damage. Generic geometry and action timing remain.

entries.name: Spellweaver
entries.whatIsScored: Team +10 AP; current member totals 20/40/65 AP. Each actual Spellweaver cast grants 1/1/2 AP to every living allied Spellweaver, including self exactly once. Shared theory, legacy team and symmetric combat use real native cast events.
entries.remaining: Static member total-versus-additional wording remains unverified. Event delivery uses each shared scheduler action boundary, retaining existing action timing assumptions. Generic own-cast AP is not treated as Spellweaver membership.

entries.name: Sprykin
entries.whatIsScored: No BFF actor, rider HP/AS or shared BFF output is scored.
entries.remaining: Needs rider/mode and verified BFF kit. Pinned rider HP +15/40/45%, AS +15/35/45%; archived tier-5 sharing ratio is 0.5, missing from sparse lookup. Prototype extras contain contradictions.

entries.name: Summoner
entries.whatIsScored: At 2/3: Yorick summon HP ×1.30/1.45; Mama Beak damage ×1.45/1.675; Azir the same on 18.1d, his own ×1.2/1.3 from 18.2b (AzirDamageMult, 2026-09-22); Zyra +4/+6 attacks.
entries.remaining: **Removed unsupported overcredit:** orphaned ExtraSummons/SummonPower mappings. Azir and Zyra keep their base summon counts. Plant attack cadence remains approximate; no live script trace was obtained.

entries.name: Thornmaiden
entries.whatIsScored: 5% base durability now reaches all allies once.
entries.remaining: **Fixed:** previously only Zyra received it. The increase to 10% with at least 6 living plants is still omitted; no unconditional higher bonus is assumed.

entries.name: Vanguard
entries.whatIsScored: 18/32/42% HP shields for 10s at start and first crossing below 50% HP; tier 6 adds 5% durability only while shielded.
entries.remaining: **Fixed:** durability was unconditional. Exact same-time shield ordering follows the engine; native verification is recorded below.

recommendations.change: On each actual Spellweaver cast, give every other eligible allied Spellweaver its tier APPerCast amount while preserving the existing one self stack.
recommendations.why: Explicit pinned wording; existing native persistent actors already supply actual casts and avoid any uptime or fight-history guess.
recommendations.validation: Unequal caster cadences, no double self credit, no nonmember credit, mana-less member recipient, cross-mode event/proc checks, canonical order.

recommendations.change: At five unique three-star units, split the existing bonus damage equally into magic and true components.
recommendations.why: Complete source formula and threshold are roster-derived; no movement, history or target-health assumption needed.
recommendations.validation: Zero/positive MR, same bonus budget before/after conversion, no recursive procs, source damage/kill identity, standalone and bridged parity.

recommendations.change: Deliver source-backed allied mana regeneration on actual Sentinel casts.
recommendations.why: Would reuse shared cast event machinery; source wording needs final recipient/self/duration/stack interpretation before adoption.
recommendations.validation: Observed cast timestamps, native mana-lock handling, receiver eligibility, no opening invented mana.

recommendations.change: Compare legal blessing selections throughout composition search; implement sourced Turtle healing and finite-target Bear executes while disclosing unmeasured rewards.
recommendations.validation: Distinct choices, complete aggregate alternatives, native/reference parity, item-search coverage, retained upgrade choices, and UI validation.

staleCoverageText: Original data/tft/set18/trait-audit.md is historical and still predates shared flat reduction and independent source assignment; the resolver messages have been corrected.
additionalLimits: Several high trait breakpoints require emblems/Avatar choices that current board search does not supply.
All comparisons use pinned source values; no mutable newer balance coefficient was silently imported.
changes: Removed the melee-carry limit from seed allocation, item search and publication validation; equipped forms remain native.
Composition scoring compares all legal Primal blessings for each allocation against one aggregate of the same 24 profiles.
Turtle heals each living actor at the sourced four-second interval, with effective healing counted in frontline EHP.
Bear has finite-combat execution support; its value and Phoenix economy remain unmeasured by the immortal-target fixed-budget scorer.
Spellweaver AP is shared on actual eligible allied casts, including the caster once.
At five unique three-star champions, Solar converts half its existing bonus to true damage, preserving the total bonus budget.

primalPolicy.twoPrimals: Four distinct single choices are compared.
primalPolicy.fourPrimals: Six distinct pairs are supported. Current ordinary roster search cannot reach four without an emblem or selected Lux origin, neither of which is supplied.
primalPolicy.aggregate: One choice applies across all sensitivity profiles (48 in v3, including both focus orientations); choices are reconsidered during item search, not independently per pressure profile.
primalPolicy.equivalentScores: Bear and Phoenix have identical direct effects in the immortal-target fixed-budget objective and share an exact calculation. All choices still appear in the evidence; zero marginal score is not zero game value.
primalPolicy.ties: Canonical Tiger/Turtle/Bear/Phoenix order breaks exact ties only, preserving the old Tiger default on ties.
primalPolicy.upgrades: Retain the parent choice, add a distinct second choice only at the higher breakpoint, and preserve ordered history separately when inactive. This no-respec contract is conservative; deactivation/reacquisition reset behavior is not verified.
primalPolicy.tiger: Keep the existing 35% total member AS / 15% other-ally AS interpretation after six seconds; whether members also gain the team share remains unresolved.

measurementNotes.coreMeleeCarryCounts: Counts core boards only, using the equipped Fighter/Assassin kind for main and secondary carries.
measurementNotes.primalSelections: Counts active choices across core boards and their level-nine upgrades together.

postAuditUpdates.change: Persistent incoming source ownership replaces one-current-source focus; Monolith coverage and Primal profile-count text updated. Original trait-audit verification above retains its original generation identity.

Timed Sunder/Shred (Caustic, Last Whisper, Void Staff, a driver's own) is applied per target and shared while it runs instead of standing coverage from the first second; auras stay standing. Solar's five-three-star true-damage share reads Threshold2TrueDamageConversion (0.4 on 18.2b). Summoner gives Azir AzirDamageMult where the patch has it.
postAuditUpdates.status: code-only; composition artifacts and the site need a warm before publication
